integrity: The unrestricted identities are proved by direct block constraints and inclusion-exclusion; exhaustive experiments are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Two named colors, labelled cocktail-party graphs, and fixed biased edge-independent model; no automorphism orbit count, no multi-color extension, and no independently certified historical priority.
title: Exact rainbow two-colour reliability and a Poisson window for cocktail-party graphs
